# KONNRA — Dongguan Konnra Electronics Co., Ltd.

> KONNRA (Dongguan Konnra Electronics Co., Ltd., established 2004) designs and manufactures electronic connectors and wire harnesses in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. It publishes part-number cross-references to JST, Molex, Hirose, and Yeonho series.

## Company Facts
- Name: KONNRA
- Legal Name: Dongguan Konnra Electronics Co., Ltd.
- Founded: 2004
- Address: No.6 Nanchang South Road, Chijiao, Wangniudun, Dongguan, Guangdong, 523200, China
- Email: sales003@konnra.com

## Quality & Automotive Certifications
- IATF 16949 (Automotive Quality Management)
- ISO 9001 (Quality Management System)
- ISO 14001 (Environmental Management)
- ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality System)
- UL International Safety Certification
- LV214 & USCAR-2 Automotive Connector Verification
- RoHS & REACH Compliance
- IPC Standard Assembly

## Production & Engineering Capabilities
- 40,000㎡ Production Area across 4 factory bases
- 53 Technical R&D Engineers
- 150M sets Monthly Production Volume
- 30+ R&D Patents
- 95%+ Factory Automation Rate
- Custom Mold Design, Precision Stamping, Automated Injection Molding & CCD Inspection

## Product Families & Cross-References
- Wire-to-Board Connectors (0.8mm, 1.0mm, 1.2mm, 1.25mm, 1.5mm, 2.0mm, 2.54mm, 3.0mm, 3.96mm, 4.2mm, 6.0mm Pitch)
- Wire-to-Wire & Board-to-Board Connectors
- Automotive TPA Connectors & Wire Harnesses
- 840+ Direct Replacements for Molex & JST Part Numbers
